no_adcom_quote.quote: Advisory Committee: This NDA was not presented before the Antiviral Products Advisory Committee. It was the third INSTI in the class. Notably, no issues were identified that required outside expertise.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for TIVICAY (dolutegravir, NDA 204790). Three review documents independently state the NDA was not referred to the Antiviral Products Advisory Committee because dolutegravir was the third INSTI-class drug, and the safety and efficacy data raised no issues requiring outside expertise (SumR L105, ODMemo L37, MedR L1148). With no AdComm meeting, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
